fixture_notice: BENCHMARK FIXTURE - synthetic cases authored for internal regression benchmarking of the AI Scientist Evolution Lab. Documents, hypotheses, designs and numbers are illustrative; they are not research findings, not real data and must never be presented as discoveries.
description: Rank candidate documents for a research query. Subject returns ranked document ids; scored by nDCG@5 (graded relevance 2 = directly relevant, 1 = partially relevant) and recall@5.

input.query: learning-rate warmup and training stability of transformers

documents.title: Warmup schedules and early-training divergence in transformers
documents.text: Removing linear learning-rate warmup from post-LayerNorm transformers produced loss spikes and divergence in most runs, while a few thousand warmup steps stabilised training.

documents.title: Variance of adaptive learning rates early in training
documents.text: The second-moment estimate of Adam has high variance during the first iterations; a warmup phase limits the effective step size until the estimate settles, which explains part of the benefit of warmup.

documents.title: Step decay versus cosine annealing for image classifiers
documents.text: Step decay and cosine schedules are compared for residual convolutional networks on image classification; warmup is not studied.

documents.title: Transformer inference latency on edge accelerators
documents.text: We profile attention kernels and quantised matrix multiplication for transformer inference on mobile accelerators.

documents.title: Layer normalisation placement and warmup-free training
documents.text: Moving layer normalisation inside the residual branch (Pre-LN) yields well-scaled gradients at initialisation, so transformers train stably without a warmup stage.

documents.title: Warm-starting networks from previously trained weights
documents.text: Initialising from weights trained on a smaller dataset can hurt generalisation compared with random initialisation.

documents.title: Temperature scaling for classifier calibration
documents.text: A single scalar temperature fitted on held-out data substantially reduces expected calibration error.

documents.title: Spectral normalisation for stable GAN training
documents.text: Constraining the Lipschitz constant of the discriminator stabilises adversarial training of generative models.

input.query: graph neural networks for molecular property prediction

documents.title: Message passing networks for quantum chemistry
documents.text: A message passing neural network over molecular graphs predicts DFT-level properties such as atomisation energy with chemical accuracy on a small-molecule dataset.

documents.title: Scaffold splits reveal optimistic GNN benchmarks
documents.text: Random splits overestimate generalisation of graph neural networks for molecular property prediction; scaffold-based splits reduce reported accuracy.

documents.title: Graph neural networks for traffic forecasting
documents.text: Spatio-temporal graph convolutions model road-sensor networks for short-term traffic speed prediction.

documents.title: Fingerprint-based random forests for solubility
documents.text: Extended connectivity fingerprints with random forests remain a strong baseline for aqueous solubility prediction.

documents.title: Molecular dynamics of lipid bilayers
documents.text: Coarse-grained simulations characterise membrane curvature induced by peptides.

documents.title: Knowledge graph embeddings for drug repurposing
documents.text: Link prediction on a biomedical knowledge graph ranks candidate drug-disease associations.

documents.title: Oversmoothing in deep graph networks
documents.text: Stacking many graph convolution layers makes node representations indistinguishable; we analyse the effect on citation networks.

documents.title: Protein-ligand docking scoring functions
documents.text: Empirical scoring functions are benchmarked for pose prediction across crystal structures.

input.query: copper electrocatalysts for CO2 reduction to ethylene selectivity

documents.title: Oxide-derived copper improves C2+ selectivity
documents.text: Copper electrodes reduced from thermally grown oxide show higher Faradaic efficiency toward ethylene than polished copper in CO2 electroreduction.

documents.title: Electrolyte cation effects in CO2 electroreduction
documents.text: Larger alkali cations increase ethylene production on copper by stabilising adsorbed CO2 intermediates at the interface.

documents.title: Hydrogen evolution on platinum nanoparticles
documents.text: Particle size effects on hydrogen evolution activity of platinum are measured in acidic electrolyte.

documents.title: Gas diffusion electrodes for high-current CO2 reduction
documents.text: Flow cells with gas diffusion electrodes reach industrially relevant current densities for CO2 reduction on copper, with selectivity depending on local pH.

documents.title: Photocatalytic water splitting on titania
documents.text: Doped titanium dioxide photocatalysts are evaluated for hydrogen production under visible light.

documents.title: Copper interconnect electromigration
documents.text: Grain boundaries control electromigration lifetime of copper interconnects in integrated circuits.

documents.title: Nickel single-atom catalysts for CO production
documents.text: Atomically dispersed nickel sites convert CO2 to CO with high selectivity but produce negligible hydrocarbons.

documents.title: Techno-economic analysis of green ammonia
documents.text: Levelised cost of ammonia from electrolytic hydrogen is estimated for several regions.

input.query: deep learning prediction of CRISPR-Cas9 off-target activity

documents.title: Convolutional models of Cas9 off-target cleavage
documents.text: A convolutional network trained on genome-wide off-target assays predicts cleavage at mismatched sites better than hand-crafted mismatch scores.

documents.title: Mismatch position effects on Cas9 specificity
documents.text: Mismatches in the PAM-proximal seed region reduce Cas9 cleavage far more than PAM-distal mismatches.

documents.title: Base editors for correcting point mutations
documents.text: Cytidine base editors achieve targeted C-to-T conversion without double-strand breaks.

documents.title: Attention models for guide RNA off-target ranking
documents.text: A transformer over guide-target sequence pairs ranks candidate off-target sites and generalises to unseen guides in cross-validation.

documents.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing clustering
documents.text: Graph-based clustering identifies cell types in single-cell transcriptomes.

documents.title: CRISPR screens for drug resistance genes

documents.title: Protein language models for variant effects
documents.text: Masked language models over protein sequences score missense variant pathogenicity.

documents.title: Delivery of Cas9 ribonucleoproteins
documents.text: Lipid nanoparticles deliver Cas9 ribonucleoprotein complexes to hepatocytes in mice.

input.query: electrolyte additives to extend lithium metal anode cycle life

documents.title: Fluoroethylene carbonate additive and lithium metal cycling
documents.text: Adding fluoroethylene carbonate forms a LiF-rich interphase that raises Coulombic efficiency and extends cycle life of lithium metal anodes.

documents.title: Lithium nitrate as a co-additive in ether electrolytes
documents.text: Lithium nitrate suppresses dendritic lithium growth in ether electrolytes and increases the number of cycles to 80 percent capacity retention.

documents.title: Cathode coatings for high-voltage nickel-rich cathodes

documents.title: Solid-state electrolytes with garnet structure
documents.text: Garnet-type oxide electrolytes enable lithium metal anodes but suffer from interfacial resistance.

documents.title: Sodium-ion battery hard carbon anodes

documents.title: Battery state-of-health estimation with machine learning
documents.text: Gradient-boosted models predict remaining useful life from early-cycle voltage curves.

documents.title: Silicon anode binders

documents.title: Thermal runaway propagation in battery packs
documents.text: Cell-to-cell thermal runaway propagation is modelled for pouch-cell modules.

input.query: data leakage from patient-level splits in medical imaging deep learning

documents.title: Patient overlap inflates chest radiograph classifier performance
documents.text: When images from the same patient appear in both training and test sets, reported AUROC is substantially higher than with patient-level splitting.

documents.title: A checklist for leakage in machine-learning-based science
documents.text: We catalogue leakage types including duplicated subjects across splits and preprocessing fitted on the full dataset, and show their prevalence in published studies.

documents.title: Self-supervised pretraining for histopathology

documents.title: Domain shift between hospitals in radiology AI

documents.title: Segmentation of brain tumours with U-Net variants
documents.text: Architectural variants of U-Net are compared on multimodal MRI tumour segmentation.

documents.title: Federated learning across hospitals
documents.text: Federated averaging trains a shared model without centralising patient images.

documents.title: Explaining imaging models with saliency maps
documents.text: Saliency maps frequently highlight image markers unrelated to pathology.

documents.title: Label noise in radiology reports
documents.text: Automatically extracted labels from radiology reports contain systematic errors.

documents.text: A Gaussian-process-based Bayesian optimiser found higher-yield conditions for a palladium-catalysed coupling in fewer experiments than chemists.

documents.title: Batch acquisition functions for parallel experimentation

documents.title: Retrosynthesis planning with Monte Carlo tree search
documents.text: Tree search over reaction templates proposes synthetic routes to target molecules.

documents.title: Reaction yield prediction from SMILES with transformers
documents.text: Sequence models predict yields of Buchwald-Hartwig reactions from reaction SMILES.

documents.title: Design of experiments for pharmaceutical crystallisation

documents.title: Hyperparameter tuning of neural networks with Bayesian optimisation
documents.text: Gaussian-process optimisation tunes learning rate and depth of image classifiers.

documents.title: Kinetic modelling of enzymatic reactions
documents.text: Michaelis-Menten parameters are estimated from progress curves.

input.query: calibration of confidence estimates in large language models

documents.title: Language models mostly know what they know
documents.text: Larger language models are reasonably well calibrated on multiple-choice questions when asked for the probability that their answer is correct.

documents.title: Verbalised confidence versus token probabilities
documents.text: Confidence stated in words by chat models is systematically overconfident compared with calibrated token-level probabilities.

documents.title: Temperature scaling for classifier calibration
documents.text: A single scalar temperature fitted on held-out data substantially reduces expected calibration error of neural classifiers.

documents.title: Efficient attention for long documents
documents.text: Sparse attention patterns reduce the memory cost of long-context transformers.

documents.title: Instruction tuning improves zero-shot generalisation
documents.text: Fine-tuning on many instruction-formatted tasks improves zero-shot performance on held-out tasks.

documents.title: Tokenizer effects on multilingual performance
documents.text: Byte-pair vocabularies disadvantage morphologically rich languages.
